```sql
-- Migration: split full_name into first_name, last_name. Idempotent.

ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS first_name VARCHAR(255);
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_name VARCHAR(255);

-- Split on first space; if no space, full_name → first_name
UPDATE users
SET 
  first_name = CASE 
    WHEN full_name LIKE '% %' 
    THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(full_name, 1, POSITION(' ' IN full_name) - 1))
    ELSE TRIM(full_name)
  END,
  last_name = CASE 
    WHEN full_name LIKE '% %' 
    THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(full_name, POSITION(' ' IN full_name) + 1))
    ELSE ''
  END
WHERE full_name IS NOT NULL AND first_name IS NULL;
```

Safe to re-run: `ADD IF NOT EXISTS` skips if columns exist, `WHERE first_name IS NULL` skips already-backfilled rows. Handles single-word names (last_name empty), multi-word names (split on first space), and NULL values (skipped). Once verified in staging, uncomment `ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN full_name;` to remove the old column.
